auditBaseline.note: Initial component review, 2026-10-16: selected Button export, Tailwind 4.3.3 and esbuild 0.28.2, automatic four-weight Roboto and Material Icons. Setup then contained every family's tokens, so setup-only CSS included the full token graph. Current CSS includes actual family imports and two Roboto weights. Changes include component fixes as well as the token/font split; this is not an isolated benchmark of one change.
